source_description: What does it feel like to be seen? Part psychology, part design museum, part observatory. The Human Room is an immersive exhibit inside Simple Minds Studios. Visitors first complete a comprehensive psychological assessment built from six research-backed frameworks (VIA Character Strengths, Big Five, Emotional Intelligence, Executive Function, CliftonStrengths, and Human Infrastructure Capacity). The assessment generates a living Human Print—not a personality label, but a multidimensional portrait of how someone thinks, learns, collaborates, leads, forms relationships, and maintains agency within complex systems.
